title: This AI Predicts If Your Video Will Go Viral
description:
Comment VIRAL and I'll send you the link.

Your videos are about to start going viral. Higgsfield just dropped Virality Predictor — upload a clip up to 15 seconds and get viral score, hook strength in the first second, and hold rate to the end. Plus a brain heatmap showing which regions light up second by second.

For ecommerce brands this changes the math on creatives. Generate 500 ad variations for your product, run each through the predictor, cut the weak ones, scale the winners. No more burning ad spend on live tests.

Right now it's free.

#ai #ecommerce #aitools #contentcreation #viralcontent
